_comment: Channel Profile Template — Copy this file and fill in all fields for a new channel.
name: 채널명 (Display Name)
niche_description: One-line description of the channel's content focus and target audience.

content.tone: Describe the speaking tone: e.g. '20대 여성, 카페에서 친구에게 수다 떠는 톤'
content.script_framework: SUCCESS + Story | Lisa Cron + SUCCESS | Hero's Journey | etc
content.hook_style: Describe how hooks are constructed: e.g. 'Provocative what-if question targeting curiosity gap'
forbidden: numbers as digits in TTS text (spell out or use Korean reading)
minus/plus symbols in TTS text (use 마이너스/플러스)

visual.style: Style name: e.g. '1980s manga', 'scientific infographic', 'watercolor illustration'
visual.prompt_suffix: Style suffix appended to ALL image prompts for this channel. Define colors, shading, lighting, texture.

audio.tts_preset: preset-name (references voice config in tts engine)
audio.audio_mastering: highpass 80Hz, EQ presence boost 2-4kHz, compressor ratio 3:1, plate reverb 0.8s, loudness -16 LUFS

upload.schedule: daily HH:MM KST | weekly DAY HH:MM KST
